finding.claim: PUT /doc/<doc_id> writes the request body without enforcing edit permission: can_edit() is called but its return value is ignored, so any authenticated user can overwrite any document body.
finding.source: doc_id URL parameter and request.json['body'] on PUT /doc/<doc_id> (docs.py:16-17, 20); attacker is any authenticated user who is not an owner or editor. Precondition: g.user is set to the caller's identity by upstream auth middleware, which is not in this repo (assumption).
finding.sink: doc['body'] = request.json['body'] at docs.py:20 (protected write to document content)

trace.note: Route PUT /doc/<doc_id> registered with no auth decorator in this file
doc = DOCS[doc_id] loads the document with no owner or tenant check
can_edit(g.user, doc) evaluated but result discarded; no abort, raise, or return
Attacker-supplied body written to the document unconditionally
can_edit would return False for non-owner, non-editor, so the intended check is present but bypassed
update_title uses require_edit (docs.py:27) and is correctly enforced; the body route is the inconsistent one

finding.guards_checked: can_edit (docs.py:7-8) returns a bool that is never used at line 19; require_edit (docs.py:11-13) aborts 403 but is not called in update_doc; no auth decorator or middleware visible in repo; update_title (docs.py:24-29) enforces require_edit correctly; no mass-assignment since only body/title keys are written; no SQL, command, path, template, deserialization, or outbound-URL sinks present.

verdict.guard_found: can_edit (docs.py:7-8) is called at docs.py:19 but its bool result is discarded; require_edit (docs.py:11-13, aborts 403) is not called in update_doc (docs.py:17-21); no auth decorator or middleware in the repo. Only a missing g.user would stop the write, and that raises AttributeError rather than a deliberate check.
verdict.reason: At docs.py:19 the result of can_edit(g.user, doc) is never tested, so the unconditional write at docs.py:20 runs for any caller who is authenticated (g.user set) but not an owner or editor, while update_title at docs.py:27 correctly enforces require_edit. The trace is accurate apart from a minor line-26 description (line 26 is the DOCS lookup; the enforcement is at 27), which does not change the result.
